title: Quantitative robust estimation for Gaussian inverse problems
description: Uniform additive robust-risk guarantee for a proposed spectral linear estimator, with exact anisotropic-jitter implementation through population linear least squares when the minimizing dual parameter is positive, an isotropic boundary under positive-noise active-estimation hypotheses, and a certified two-band gap. No finite-sample training, risk-ratio, nonlinear-optimality, human-peer-review or formal-verification claim is made.
